storyCards.headline: Summer Of '69: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Bryan Adams's "Summer Of '69" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Summer Of '69 was released in 1985.
